title: 2005 - Hong Kong International Wireless Conference 2005
author: hkwtia
plainText: Thousands of visitors from globe participated this international event organized by WTIA. The event consisted of presentation by reputable speakers and exhibition of 20 local wireless technology applications and solutions providers.
